question: When did Caroline go to the LGBTQ support group?
context: Session 1: (1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023) Caroline: Hey Mel! Good to see you. Melanie: You too! How have you been? Caroline: Pretty good. I finally went to that LGBTQ support group on the 7th of May and it was lovely. Session 2: (3:10 pm on 15 May, 2023) Melanie: I went to the beach this weekend with the kids. Caroline: That sounds wonderful. Session 3: (9:02 am on 2 June, 2023) Caroline: I've been thinking back on how supported I felt at that group last month.
